item.title: Report: Iran uses decoys, rapidly rebuilds missile launch sites after US, Israel strikes
item.description: US intelligence reports say Iran can rebuild ballistic missile bunkers and launch shafts within hours after strikes, and still retains a significant stockpile of missiles and mobile launchers

item.title: Lebanese president urges talks with Israel as IDF strikes Hezbollah targets in Beirut’s Dahieh
item.description: Joseph Aoun says negotiations are the only way to stop devastation as Israel expands strikes against Hezbollah; no ceasefire response yet, he says, warning Lebanon risks the fate of Gaza while regional tensions continue to escalate

item.title: 10 impact sites after Iran fires cluster missile; Tehran claims strike on 'Israel-linked ship'
item.description: Apartments damaged in Ramat Gan and vehicles set ablaze, with multiple impact sites across central Israel; no injuries reported as Iran claims strike on an Israel-linked ship in Hormuz

item.title: Israel braces for major escalation as Trump’s Iran deadline nears
item.description: With Trump’s ultimatum set to expire early Wednesday Israel time, officials are preparing for possible strikes on Iranian energy and infrastructure targets, even as mediators race to secure a last-minute deal and avert a wider regional war

item.title: Trump: ‘We got him’ after US commando rescue of downed navigator deep inside Iran under heavy fire
item.description: US forces carried out two-day operation involving hundreds of troops, airstrikes and firefights to extract F-15E navigator; aircraft malfunction forced dramatic changes as all forces exited Iran safely, officials say

item.title: Israel set to start striking energy facilities in Iran next week, official says
item.description: Senior defense official tells Reuters Jerusalem is waiting for green light from US as Donald Trump issues 48-hour ultimatum to Tehran

item.title: איפה נופלים הטילים? האתרים שמציגים בזמן אמת את מפת המלחמה עם איראן
item.description: עוד לפני מבצע "שאגת הארי", נולד בישראל אקוסיסטם של מפות והתרעות שמרכז בזמן אמת נתוני שיגורים, יירוטים ושיבושי GPS. יוזמות עצמאיות ואתרי חדשות מציגים לציבור מידע שבעבר היה שמור לחמ"לים צבאיים בלבד. בעולם של איומים מתמשכים, הדאטה הפך לכלי הישרדות של ממש

item.title: Multi-front attack: Iran, Hezbollah, Yemen fire hits Tel Aviv area; 1 injured
item.description: Direct hits from a cluster missile in central Israel damage buildings in Ramat Gan, Petah Tikva and Bnei Brak

item.title: קלוד תחת אש: טראמפ רוצה לזרוק, אבל הצבא חייב אותו
item.description: אחרי שהקריס את המניות של ענקיות הטק והציב איום על פרנסתם של המתכנתים, מודל ה–AI "קלוד" מחולל מהפכה גם במלחמה עם איראן ועוזר לצבא האמריקאי לשפר את הביצועים. אנת'רופיק, המפתחת שלו, מתעקשת להגדיר קווים מוסריים לשימוש בו ומוציאה את טראמפ מהכלים

item.title: From automatic support to political risk: Israel is now a burden for Democratic Party candidates
item.description: Less than three year to US presidential elections and just a few months before the midterms, almost all Democratic leaders are making clear their aversion to Israel and openly talking about breaking away from it - and are saying things about Israel that were once unimaginable
